services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to book an appointment for Zirconia Crown at Sridevi Dental. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Patients with a cracked, heavily filled or root-canal-treated tooth.

services.name: Tooth Extraction

services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to book an appointment for Tooth Extraction at Sridevi Dental. My name is:

reviews.name: Lakshmi Prasanna
reviews.text: I came for scaling and polishing. I waited 12 minutes, and Nandini at reception explained the ₹1,200 charge before I went in. My teeth felt noticeably cleaner the same evening.

reviews.name: Srinivas Rao
reviews.text: Dr. Sridevi completed my single-sitting root canal without rushing. The ₹5,500 estimate was the amount billed, and I received clear instructions for the numbness and medicine.

reviews.name: Madhuri S.
reviews.text: My zirconia crown shade was checked beside my natural teeth twice before fitting. The assistant called the next day to ask whether the bite still felt high.

reviews.name: Kiran Kumar
reviews.text: The braces consultation was clear and the ₹42,000 plan was quoted before scans. Saturday evening was busy, so I waited about 18 minutes longer than the booked time.
reviews.ownerReply: Reply from Dr. Sridevi: Thank you, Kiran. We now keep a separate Saturday scan slot after 6:30 PM so braces reviews do not wait behind walk-ins.

reviews.name: Rajeswari Devi
reviews.text: I was worried about an implant after losing a back tooth. Dr. Sridevi showed the X-ray on screen and explained the separate implant and crown costs before I agreed.

faqs.question: Can I book an evening appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday to Saturday appointments are available until 8:30 PM.

contactFaqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?
contactFaqs.answer: Yes, when a doctor is free. Call before leaving home so we can tell you the current wait.

contactFaqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
contactFaqs.answer: We help with eligible cashless claims. Bring your card and policy details so the team can check the process.

contactFaqs.question: Is EMI available?
contactFaqs.answer: EMI is available for eligible treatments above ₹15,000. Ask for the current card and bank options at reception.

contactFaqs.question: Do you treat children?
contactFaqs.answer: Yes. Dr. Anusha sees children for preventive visits, fluoride treatment and early decay concerns.

contactFaqs.question: Is parking available?
contactFaqs.answer: Two-wheelers can park beside the building. Car parking is easier at the service road after 5:00 PM.

contactFaqs.question: What are Sunday timings?
contactFaqs.answer: Sunday appointments are available from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

story: Sridevi Dental began in 2011 with one chair in Governorpet and a simple promise: explain the problem before proposing a treatment.

As more families travelled from Patamata and Benz Circle, the clinic moved to its current location in 2016. The second operatory was added in 2021 so longer procedures and routine appointments could run without making patients wait.
Today the team still works in the same practical way. You see the X-ray, understand the cost and leave with clear instructions.

sterilization.text: Each reusable instrument set is packed, marked and logged before it returns to a treatment room.
